TIARCA — TIARCA Is Another Relay Chat App
Version %1$s

Original project
TIARCA is a fork of Revolution IRC, originally developed by MrARM/MCMrARM and distributed under the GNU GPLv3.

TIARCA continues its independent development with modifications, fixes and new features.

Licensed under the GNU General Public License v3. The corresponding source code and notices must be made available with public distributions.

Includes open-source Android libraries; their respective licences remain in force.

Media sharing may use the external Simosnap service. Uploaded files are governed by that service’s availability and retention policies.

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

%s (from server: %s) has sent you a file.\n\nWarning: This download will be transmitted over an insecure & unencrypted connection. Accepting this download will allow the other party to see your IP address. You should accept it only if you trust this user.

DCC is a legacy peer to peer file sharing protocol and the files are sent over an insecure and unencrypted connection. This means that all data sent using the feature can potentially be copied or manipulated by attackers, especially on public WiFi networks.
Additionally, due to the protocol's nature when you share files using DCC, you are also giving your IP address to the other party. DCC generally does not work when using mobile data, and may not work on some WiFi connections.

Because of this, we recommend that you instead use 3rd party sharing services and only share a link with the target user instead of DCC.
